enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Snore. Stir. Turn over. Continue sleeping. Wake briefly. Turn again. Fall back asleep. Remain asleep.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into bowl. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Open cupboard. Take out plate and place eggs on it. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Walk to sink and rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Put on shirt and pants. Open drawer. Take out socks and shoes. Put on socks and shoes. Open work bag. Put laptop, notebook, pen in bag. Close bag. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk out of house. Close door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Answer phone. Talk on phone. Write notes. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Attend meeting. Take notes. Return to desk. Open document. Edit document. Print document. Pick up printout. File document. Make phone call and hang up. Check calendar and schedule appointment.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at a nearby cafe
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Walk to counter. Look at menu. Order sandwich and coffee. Pay cashier. Wait for order. Pick up sandwich and coffee. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink coffee. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Pick up tray. Walk to trash bin. Throw away trash. Walk out of cafe. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, program administration and meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Check email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Write report. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Talk on phone. Hang up. File documents. Organize files. Print documents. Pick up printouts. Staple documents. Distribute documents. Talk to colleagues. Return to desk. Continue working on computer.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to house. Enter house. Close door. Take off shoes.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Place pan on induction cooker and turn on. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables and chicken. Stir. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Open cupboard. Take out plate and place food on it. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink and rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe stove. Put cloth away. Sweep floor.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and planning the next day's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Close book. Put book down. Pick up phone. Open calendar. Check schedule. Write notes. Put phone down. Pick up notebook. Write to-do list. Close notebook. Put notebook down. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Snore. Stir. Turn over. Continue sleeping. Wake briefly. Turn again. Fall back asleep. Remain asleep.
